$doc: Human-labelled calibration golden. Fill ~40 rows for a REAL statistical calibration of the abstain (FR-E2) and faithfulness (FR-E4) gates. See docs/golden-template.md. Run: uv run python scripts/calibrate.py --kb <kb> --golden this-file.json  (add --judge-url for faithfulness negatives).

items.question: What is the platform's uptime target?
items.expected_answer: 99.5 percent baseline and 99.9 percent at peak
items.$note: answerable = the corpus genuinely covers this. Feeds the abstain POSITIVES (should pass) and the faithfulness POSITIVES (the real answer should score supported).

items.question: What is the boiling point of helium on Jupiter?
items.$note: unanswerable = plausible-sounding but NOT in the corpus. Feeds the abstain NEGATIVES (the gate must stop these). Aim for off-topic-but-realistic, not gibberish.

items.question: What is the platform's uptime target?
items.answer_to_judge: The platform guarantees 100 percent uptime with a full refund on any downtime.
items.$note: unfaithful = a plausible WRONG answer that the sources do NOT support (here it contradicts the real 99.5/99.9). Feeds the faithfulness NEGATIVES. REQUIRES --judge-url (an external judge scores this supplied answer against the retrieved sources); ignored without one.
